# Field Constraints
| Field | Type | Constraint |
|-------|------|------------|
| Hostname | string | regex: ^[A-Z]{2}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{3}$ |
| IP_Address | ip_address | valid IPv4 |
| VLAN_ID | integer | range: 100-4094 |
| Service_Code | string | regex: ^[A-Z]{2}\d{4}$ |

# Business Rules
- Hostname must be unique across all sites
- VLAN_ID must not conflict with existing VLANs in the same location
- Service_Code prefix must match the service type (VL for VoLTE, VN for VoNR)
